settings.title: Settings
settings.whats_new.title: Highlights of this update
settings.whats_new.v290.tagline: Chat → Code apply workflow — 'Apply to file' button + hunk-level accept/reject
settings.whats_new.v290.bullet_0: 'Apply to file' button on chat code blocks — one-click apply to the current open file
settings.whats_new.v290.bullet_1: Inline diff preview before apply — disk vs new code via unified merge view
settings.whats_new.v290.bullet_2: Hunk-level accept/reject — pick which changes to apply with inline toggles
settings.whats_new.v290.bullet_3: Atomic write + expected_mtime conflict handling — toast on external change
settings.whats_new.v290.bullet_4: Auto-sync editor baseline after apply — change gutter / dirty stays accurate
settings.whats_new.v280.tagline: Builder UX polish — file navigation + editor context + chat→code hand-off
settings.whats_new.v280.bullet_0: FileTree folder hierarchy + Mod+P quick file open + path breadcrumb
settings.whats_new.v280.bullet_1: Recent files (top of Quick Open) + filename and unsaved marker in window title
settings.whats_new.v280.bullet_2: Change gutter in edit mode — modified (blue) / added (green) line markers
settings.whats_new.v280.bullet_3: Code outline panel — jump to functions / classes / methods / Markdown headings
settings.whats_new.v280.bullet_4: 'Send to Code' button on chat code blocks — clipboard copy + auto switch to Code mode
settings.whats_new.v270.tagline: Code mode: editing + save + external-change detection
settings.whats_new.v270.bullet_0: Code mode: sidebar [Code] → right panel switches to file tree + editor
settings.whats_new.v270.bullet_2: Edit ⇄ View toggle — Mod+S to save, Mod+E to toggle
settings.whats_new.v270.bullet_3: Diff view — inline compare between disk and current draft
settings.whats_new.v270.bullet_4: External-change detection — banner appears when the file changes elsewhere
settings.whats_new.v241.bullet_0: Removed all emojis and unified to Lucide icons (30+ locations)
settings.whats_new.v241.bullet_1: Toast / badges / workspace / permission modal / onboarding / preview throughout
settings.whats_new.v241.bullet_2: Re-introduction blocked by an automated lint rule at review time

settings.diagnose.title: Database diagnostics
settings.diagnose.description: Inspect SQLite native module, database integrity, and runtime info. If anything is wrong, follow the hints below.
settings.diagnose.workspace_backfill.des: Convert workspace ids created before v1.4.0 to deterministic sha256-based ids. Same path → same id across machines. Atomic via transaction.
settings.diagnose.telemetry.title: Telemetry opt-in
settings.diagnose.telemetry.description: Send anonymous error/usage events to Sentry. Only emits if SENTRY_DSN env is set, otherwise console fallback. PII (conversations / file paths) is never sent.
